name: Pokemon Battle Arena
description: A fan-made browser battle game inspired by the classic Pokemon games. Challenge the AI in Single Player, compete in the Pokemon League, or go head-to-head against real players in Multiplayer and Ranked matches!

name: DSTRYR Pixel Dungeon
description: Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike game with pixel-art graphics and a simple interface. Explore the depths of Pixel Dungeon, collect useful items, fight fierce monsters, and find the Amulet of Yendor - the ultimate artifact of this game world. Many people consider this game very difficult and luck-based. Anyway, you will die often. You are warned!
